title: GetMetaTypesResponseSchema 没有声明 schema 和 form：每个 /meta/types 条目都在下发这两个键
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a contract defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7125340250, item 2). Source: L1 7125297029 and L2 7125274794 on PR #36881 (#36860 part a), outside that diff.

## What happens

Every `/meta/types` entry carries `schema` and `form`. The wire schema `GetMetaTypesResponseSchema` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (~210, main d95d34f8) declares neither. PR #36881 declares the new `list` key, but the two older keys stay undeclared. A typed client, and the generated contract, cannot see two members the server always sends.

reach: read by the L1 and L2. It reaches anyone building a client against the published protocol types.

## Expected

The wire schema declares every member the route serves.

## Acceptance

- `GetMetaTypesResponseSchema` declares `schema` and `form` with their real shapes, using the existing form-layout schema rather than `z.unknown()` where one exists.
- The generated contract and baselines are refreshed. A `Metadata-protocol` line is in the changeset, as the repository requires.
- A test parses a real `/meta/types` answer with the schema, strictly.

## Order

With or after PR #36881, so the three keys are declared together. Before #36860 part (b).

Dedupe: open issues for `GetMetaTypesResponseSchema` return only #36860, the parent this follows.
